title: 第2178章 或者说是他留下的最后一道考验第2177章 那个人果然不是池中之物
slug: 镇守仙秦地牢吞妖六十年
content_zh:
铁屠落地时，靴底踩在沙土地上，发出一声轻响。
他回头看了一眼身后那道正在闭合的虚空裂隙，脸上没什么表情。
跟了大人这么久，他已经不会为这种事大惊小怪了。
战魁城的大门敞开着。
战魁魁梧的身影立在门前，手按在腰间的脊骨战斧上，已经等了一会儿。
他身后站着苍青，手中握着一柄剑。
重剑。
他看向张远，目光快速扫过。
先是看他有没有受伤，然后看他腰间。
张远的腰间，多了一根赤红色的长鞭。
鞭身只有不到两尺长，暗沉古朴，盘绕在腰间。
战魁的瞳孔微微一缩，随即咧嘴笑了起来。
“大人出手，果然没有拿不下来的东西。”
张远没有说话，微微点了点头，目光掠过战魁，落在他身后的苍青手中。
苍青双手托着重剑，走上前来。
重剑上的裂纹已经完全修复了。
那些原本触目惊心的裂口，此刻被一层暗金色的金属填充覆盖，与原剑身融为一体。
剑身中段曾经凹陷变形的那个位置也已经恢复了原状，线条流畅笔直。
剑身与剑格的连接处，有几道极细的银色纹路，像树叶的脉络，从连接处向外延伸，蔓延到剑身的三分之一处。
那是苍青以封印残纹锻造法留下的修复痕迹。

张远接过重剑。
剑身入手，温热的触感透过掌心传来。
他握紧剑柄，向剑身中注入了一丝力量。
重剑发出一声清越的剑鸣。
那剑鸣比之前更加浑厚、更加凝实。
剑灵在剑鸣中，传达出一股清晰的意志。
它在感谢，同时也在示意自己已经可以重新投入战斗。
它的气息比受损之前更加精纯，那几道银色纹路将它的战意增幅了些许。
张远点了点头，将剑挂回腰间。
重剑入鞘，与炎鞭并排悬在身侧。
当天夜里，战魁城的城墙上。
张远站在垛口旁，夜风吹动他的衣袍。
铁屠从台阶上走上来，手里拿着一封信。
信封用北域特有的赤血犀皮制成，质地粗粝，微微泛红。
封口处用火漆封缄，火漆上印着一个猩红色的印记，是一道从底部向上蔓延的血色纹路，如同一棵正在逆生长的枯树。
“大人，今早在你房门下发现的。”
铁屠将信递上，眉头微皱，“我问过守卫，没有人靠近过你的院子。”
张远接过信封，看了一眼那个印记。
content_en:
When Tie Tu landed, the soles of his boots made a soft sound as they stepped on the sand.
He looked back at the closing void rift behind him, his face expressionless.
After following the adults for so long, he no longer makes a fuss about such things.
The gate of Zhankui City is open.
The burly figure stood in front of the door, his hand pressed on the spine tomahawk on his waist, and he had been waiting for a while.
Behind him stood Cang Qing, holding a sword in his hand.
Heavy sword.
He looked at Zhang Yuan and swept his eyes quickly.
First, look to see if he was injured, and then look at his waist.
Zhang Yuan had a long red whip on his waist.
The whip body is less than two feet long, dark and simple, and coiled around the waist.
The war chief's pupils shrank slightly, and then he grinned.
"My lord, there is nothing that cannot be taken away."
Zhang Yuan didn't speak, nodded slightly, and glanced at Zhan Kui, landing on Cang Qing's hands behind him.
Cang Qing stepped forward with a heavy sword in both hands.
The cracks on the epee have been completely repaired.
Those originally shocking cracks were now covered with a layer of dark golden metal filling, integrating with the original sword body.
The area in the middle of the sword that had been dented and deformed has also returned to its original shape, with smooth and straight lines.
At the connection between the sword body and the sword grid, there are several very fine silver lines, like the veins of leaves, extending outward from the connection and spreading to one third of the sword body.
Those are the repair marks left by Cang Qing's seal residual pattern forging method.
Zhang Yuan took the epee.
Taking the sword into his hands, a warm touch came through his palm.
He gripped the hilt of the sword tightly and injected a bit of power into the blade.
The heavy sword made a clear sword cry.
The sword sound was thicker and more solid than before.
The sword spirit conveyed a clear will in the sound of the sword.
It was thanking and signaling that it was ready to return to the fight.
Its aura was purer than before it was damaged, and those silver lines slightly increased its fighting spirit.
Zhang Yuan nodded and hung the sword back on his waist.
The heavy sword was sheathed and hung side by side with the flaming whip.
That night, on the wall of Zhankui City.
Zhang Yuan stood beside the crenel, his clothes fluttering in the night wind.
Tie Tu came up from the steps, holding a letter in his hand.
The envelope is made of red blood rhinoceros skin unique to the Northern Territory. It has a rough texture and is slightly reddish.
The seal was sealed with fire paint, and there was a scarlet mark printed on the fire paint. It was a bloody line that spread upward from the bottom, like a dead tree that was growing backwards.
"My lord, I found it under your door this morning."
Tie Tu handed over the letter and frowned slightly, "I asked the guards and no one has been near your yard."
Zhang Yuan took the envelope and glanced at the mark.
